name: gc10-10.3-understand-linux
title: Lab GC10, part 1: get the lab, look at ExampleCo's Google Cloud setup, and see how Google Cloud proves, decides and records one request (explore.py: org, auth, policy, decide, call, event) before attacking it

steps.label: Allowed
steps.type: python3 explore.py decide alice aiplatform.endpoints.predict example-ds-sandbox

steps.label: Inherited
steps.type: python3 explore.py decide legacy-etl aiplatform.endpoints.deploy example-chatbot-prod

steps.label: No role
steps.type: python3 explore.py decide sam aiplatform.endpoints.predict example-ds-sandbox

steps.label: Org policy deny
steps.type: python3 explore.py decide chatbot-runtime aiplatform.endpoints.predict example-chatbot-prod --model gemini-3.5-flash --fixes

steps.label: Call
steps.type: python3 explore.py call chatbot-runtime gemini-3.1-flash-lite example-chatbot-prod

steps.label: Call with a key
steps.type: python3 explore.py call chatbot-frontend gemini-3.5-flash example-chatbot-prod --from 203.0.113.50
